title: PCSO Lotto Results: Lone Lotto 6/42 bettor wins over P21M jackpot on October 29, 2026
summary: A Lotto 6/42 bettor won more than P21 million in the draw on Thursday, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced.

blocks.text: A Lotto 6/42 bettor won more than P21 million in the draw on Thursday, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced.
The winning Lotto 6/42 numbers of 34-15-19-37-25-38 unlocked a jackpot prize of 21,694,699.03.
Meanwhile, there was no winner for Super Lotto 6/49 and its P74,930,008.99 prize, with the combination 44-12-20-31-35-19.
